response.sql: SELECT AVG(`ANA`), COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE CAST(`Examination Date` AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17'

assumptions.assumption: The range is inclusive of both endpoints (BETWEEN), compared as text on the stored YYYY-MM-DD format.
The record count is the number of all examination rows in the range, including rows where ANA is NULL; only the average ignores NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only examinations that have a non-missing ANA value, so the count matches the rows used in the average.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(`ANA`), COUNT(`ANA`) FROM Examination WHERE CAST(`Examination Date` AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17'
